text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we walk along the river on our way back, I think of the puppy that Air Groove ended up taking home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to ask her about how the dog is doing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. I received special permission to allow the pup to stay in my dorm room. The dorm mistress helps out when I'm not around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have to say, she's very smart. She learns quickly, and I don't need to correct any bad behavior more than once.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you could learn a thing or two from her, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove emanates an aura of positivity and kindness as she brags about her puppy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out to buy some dog food and treats now. Care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Air Groove! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, here already, Taiki? Strange to see you actually show up on time for once.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You betcha! Leave the puppy biz to me! If you're the mama, then I'll be the papa!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Where in the world did this mama and papa stuff come from?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I have to deal with this ridiculous rigmarole from my roommate every day as well… I'm sick of it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, hold on just a minute! Are you sayin' Fine is tryin' to cut in on my job as papa?! Grrr, I'm not gonna take that sittin' down!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Enough, enough… I'm starting to feel a headache coming on. Let's go—pet supplies are this way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us head to the pet supply section, and Air Groove stops in front of a shelf of dog toys.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then, Taiki. A crumb of your wisdom, if you wouldn't mind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You betcha! I knew every sheepdog back on the ranch like they were my very own family! Fire away, pardner!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'd like you to speak up if you think of anything, as well. Now, let's commence the toy selection process!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw, let's get to it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Air Grooooove? Check out this super-duper-jumbo-size bone!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's larger than the dog! No—absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The toy selection is off to what I think is supposed to be a good start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Air Groove buys a small rubber ball that can hold a treat inside.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y-you're really gonna pass on that big ball? Ngh, what a cryin' shame…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Taiki… What is with this unfathomable trust you place in large things? I swear…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All the same, it's been… educational… having you here. You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hold up, Air Groove! You're callin' it quits already?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Look at all the yummy doggy treats! They've got jerky, biscuits, cake—the whole enchilada! Let's get 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I suppose treats can be a useful tool to get a puppy's attention…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But I'm only taking care of her for a short while. I can't foster too close a relationship…
choice_data_list: Everyone needs a reward now and then.
Woof woof! Won'tcha feed a poor pup?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice assist! I knew you were a good'un!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Loosen up, Air Groove. Do ya care about the pupper, or don'tcha?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: With a treat or three, we'll have a happy puppy before long! And a happy pup makes you a happy duck!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What an awful tag team you two make…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine. Every now and then won't hurt. I'll buy some.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove acquiesces with a shrewd smile and buys some doggy treats.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me? For your own sake, I hope that wasn't an impression of our little friend.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've done it now! Hold it right there, and I'll show you at length just how far your feeble imitation falls from the mark!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa there, Air Groove! Calm your jets!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: C'mon, a cute pupster deserves a treat now and then! It's the recipe for even greater cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hrm…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let me paint a picture for you, Air Groove. You've got the dog biscuit in hand, and the pup dashes towards ya, all barks and wags! Woof, woof, wahoo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine. But just so we're clear, I'm not doing this because of your silly charade, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm just… bowing to Taiki's greater experience in raising dogs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, Air Groove goes home with some dog treats in her bag.
